identity.name: Classic Fusion
identity.one_liner: The 45mm Classic Fusion — the toned-down Big Bang with the Sellita-based HUB1112 and a thinner profile, Hublot's entry into the integrated-bracelet segment.

narrative.story: The Classic Fusion (2010) is the simpler sibling of the Big Bang: a thinner case (9.4mm vs 15mm), a Sellita SW300-1-based HUB1112 movement instead of the in-house Unico, and a cleaner dial without a chronograph. The 45mm titanium case retains the layered case middle and the 6-screw bezel. The Classic Fusion is Hublot's most-cited dress/sport watch and the watch a collector cites when they want the Hublot design language without the flyback-chronograph complication or the 15mm case height.
narrative.collector_notes: The HUB1112 is a Sellita SW300-1 base — not an in-house movement. The Classic Fusion is available in 38mm, 42mm, and 45mm; the 45mm is the most-cited.
